description: Intended-profile sanity test for the saved semantic-search index. Each query was written from one profile; other returned profiles may also be valid matches. 'direct' cases use the role and key skills, 'paraphrase' cases express the same need in plain words, 'profile_details' cases need information beyond the role and skills (bio, earlier roles, job descriptions, certifications, education, languages, or a most recent role found by sorting jobs by date), and 'location' cases ask for a role that appears more than once in the index, so the city and state separate the intended profile from the others.
